definitions.explanation: Very polite term for someone else's mother, used to show respect to the listener or a third party. In some traditional or well-to-do families, children also use it to address their own mother. More formal than お{母|かあ}さん.

examples.japanese: お{母様|かあさま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
お{母様|かあさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→先日：03305_senjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{母様|かあさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただきました→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: The other day Mr. Tanaka's mother gave me some homemade sweets.

notes:
The honorific prefix お plus the honorific suffix ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧. Used mainly for the listener's or a third party's mother; when talking about your own mother to outsiders, say ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧.

REGISTER:
From casual to formal:
- ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧ / ⟦お{母|かあ}ちゃん→お母ちゃん：21588_okaachan⟧: mom, mommy — casual, often childlike
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧: my mother — humble; for your own mother when talking to outsiders
- ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧: mother — standard polite
- お{母様|かあさま}: mother — very polite, usually someone else's mother

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{母様|かあさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧: (give my) regards to your mother
- ⟦お{父様|とうさま}→お父様：27446_otousama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧お{母様|かあさま}: your father and mother (formal letters, greetings)
- ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{母様|かあさま}: her mother (respectful)
